findings.current: *Even being generous, he looks well into his fifties.*
findings.defect: “Well into his fifties” makes him appear older than the source specifies.
findings.rationale: 오십 줄은 넘어 means past fifty, not necessarily well into that decade.
findings.replacement: *Even being generous, he looks over fifty.*
findings.source: ‘아무리 좋게 봐줘도 오십 줄은 넘어 보여.’

findings.current: after the coup led by the Embroidered Uniform Guard succeeded, the East Depot became something of a liability to the Emperor.
findings.defect: “Liability” loses the dilemma in 계륵: something of little use that one is nevertheless reluctant to discard.
findings.rationale: Ma Sanbao describes an awkward institution the Emperor keeps despite finding it of limited value, not merely a harmful one.
findings.replacement: after the coup led by the Embroidered Uniform Guard succeeded, the East Depot became something the Emperor had little use for but couldn’t simply discard.
findings.source: 금의위가 주도한 역모가 성공한 이후부터 동창은 계륵(鷄肋)과 같은 존재였네.

findings.current: Hong Jin was a loyal subject whom the late Emperor had trusted enough to put in charge of Prince Shangshan.
findings.defect: “Put in charge of” suggests authority over the prince rather than responsibility for his care, and drops the late Emperor’s affection for Hong Jin.
findings.rationale: The late Emperor valued Hong Jin and entrusted the prince to him; Hong Jin was not placed in command of the prince.
findings.replacement: Hong Jin was a loyal retainer the late Emperor had cherished enough to entrust with Prince Shangshan’s care.
findings.source: 홍진은 상산왕을 맡길 만큼 선황이 아끼던 충복이고

findings.current: “They’re not only loyal. Though perhaps not as much as the Slaughter Saint, who is close to you.”
findings.defect: The English leaves the comparison attached to loyalty, whereas the Emperor is adding that the guards are skilled, though not as skilled as the Slaughter Saint.
findings.rationale: 충성심만 대단한 것은 아니지 shifts from loyalty to the guards’ other abilities; the Slaughter Saint comparison qualifies those abilities.
findings.replacement: “Loyalty isn’t all they have. They’re no match for the Slaughter Saint you’re close to, of course.”
findings.source: “충성심만 대단한 것은 아니지. 그대와 가까운 사이인 살성(殺星)만큼은 아니겠지만.”

findings.defect: The Emperor actually recites the deferential phrase he expects Taekyung to use. “You should be” turns the etiquette correction into a menacing retort and weakens the reason for Taekyung’s confusion.
findings.rationale: The Emperor says 황공하옵니다 as a model, then explains that Taekyung should say it instead of apologizing.
findings.replacement: “I stand in fear and awe, Your Majesty.”
findings.source:
“황공하옵니다.”

“예?”

“죄송한 것이 아니라, 황공해야 한다는 말이다. 짐을 대하는 모두가 그렇게 하는 것처럼.”

findings.current: They melted away into various corners of the room, leaving behind only the faintest trace of their presence.
findings.defect: “Corners of the room” narrows their disappearance to one room; the source places them throughout the Emperor’s quarters.
findings.rationale: 처소 곳곳 refers to various parts of the quarters, not specifically the room’s corners.
findings.replacement: They seemed to melt away throughout the Emperor’s quarters, leaving behind only the faintest trace of their presence.
findings.source: 처소 곳곳으로 녹아들 듯 사라지는 은잠술은 가히 신기(神技)에 가까웠다.

findings.current: “Though I don’t know whether it will be a curse or a blessing.”
findings.defect: “Curse” drops the Emperor’s pointed image of the inherited trait becoming poison.
findings.rationale: 독 and 득 set up a sharp contrast between poison and benefit as he assesses his brother’s inherited aptitude.
findings.replacement: “Though I don’t know whether that will prove a poison or a boon.”

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but several lines alter the Emperor’s meaning or blur political and family relationships.
